label: S5-M1-no-uniqueness-check
why: Deletes the uniqueness check of §5.4: every record becomes an append, so a second conflicting outcome for one finding is stored beside the first and decision 5's 'exactly one' becomes prose. This is the mutant the task's acceptance names, and the conflicting-refusal test is the one that has to kill it — a test that only counted rows after a happy-path record would not.
old: prior = [r for r in existing if outcome_key(r) == key]

label: S5-M2-idempotent-becomes-append
why: Collapses the idempotent answer into the append answer, which is the OTHER half of the key: a retried recorder (an interrupted agent re-running its own command) then writes a second row and the finding is counted twice. Three answers rather than two is the property, and this mutant removes one of them while leaving every refusal intact.
